outcome: Hemoglobin difference before and after surgery
cohort: 40 women with complete placenta previa admitted to Taixing People's Hospital for elective cesarean delivery between January 2019 and December 2020
finding: Prophylactic uterine artery embolization (PUAE) during cesarean delivery significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss and transfusion volume in patients with complete placenta previa.
birth_weight: Recorded, but no findings reported relating to birth weight.
